name: DSEC — Stereo Event Camera Dataset for Driving Scenarios
description: High-resolution stereo event camera dataset for automotive perception developed by the Robotics and Perception Group at the University of Zurich. Features synchronized data from a stereo pair of high-resolution Prophesee event cameras (640x480), a stereo pair of global-shutter RGB cameras (1440x1080), a Velodyne VLS-128 LiDAR, and RTK-GNSS/IMU. Captures 53 diverse driving sequences in Zurich, Switzerland, across day, dusk, night, and adverse illumination conditions for optical flow and disparity benchmarks.
